correctness.rationale: The two-site Bloch projections give s_even(k) -(w/a)v(k) exactly. Smooth gapped-band moment convergence leads to a weighted speed pushforward; the equal-bond degeneracy is handled independently by the scalar one-site Fourier transform. The map theta=arg(e^{ik}+r) has Jacobian 1+r cos(theta)/sqrt(1-r^2 sin^2(theta)), whose added term integrates to zero against arbitrary continuous functions of sin(theta). This yields the arcsine pushforward and tilted density for all positive bonds, which is normalized and nonnegative using |w|<=1/2 and m<=a. All moment and extremal-bias formulas follow. A standalone finite checker passed 198 assertions; numerical data are not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparison finds Machida 2023 Theorem 1 only for a single initially localized site, while the present exact coherent two-site probability law is generally asymmetric. Boutet de Monvel–Sabri 2022 Theorem 5.5 already proves general pushforward convergence for any periodic graph and initial state, hence the new content is only its nontrivial explicit coherent-dimer evaluation and phase classification, not existence. Harter et al. 2018 discuss mean displacement under non-Hermitian/lossy dynamics. Focused published-claim and primary-literature searches identified no exact duplicate. Residual possibility of a previously unstated/unindexed closed-form corollary is noted.
residual_risks: The older general arbitrary-state pushforward theorem supplies a stronger abstract integral; the scientific originality rests on whether explicit evaluation and exact coherence collapse count as nonroutine contribution.

value.rationale: The smallest coherent preparation not covered by the motivating source yields a complete, experimentally interpretable family of ballistic transport laws. Its entire even-moment sequence is fixed by the weaker bond, while a single imaginary coherence governs all odd moments, asymmetry, and the sharp attainable directional imbalance. It is a natural exact classification (not an arbitrary slice or a mere mean computation), useful for distinguishing phase-sensitive ballistic motion from symmetric localized preparations.
